summary: Marks a stamped block so the placer can recognise its own output.
overview: A tag component the placer puts on what it stamps, so it can tell its own blocks from everything else in the scene. Nothing to configure.
useCases: Letting the placer identify and replace blocks it created.
Selecting every greyboxed block without hand-picking them.

gotchas.title: It is a marker, not behaviour
gotchas.body: Removing it does not delete the block; it just stops the placer recognising it.
